detail.longDescription:
Manage all your Azure DevOps projects with this beautiful and easy to use app.

Az DevOps lets you access many of the features offered by Azure DevOps from your smartphone, with a nice UI that makes working with your daily DevOps tasks even more enjoyable.

Az DevOps offers the following features:
- Login with Microsoft (or with your Personal Access Token)
- Manage your work items. Specifically, you can create, edit and delete a work item, add comments and add attachments
- Manage your team's boards and sprints
- Manage your pipelines. You can cancel and rerun a pipeline, and you can also see the pipeline's logs
- Manage your projects, repos and commits (with file diff)
- Manage your pull requests. You can approve, reject and complete a pull request, and you can also add comments to it.
- Switch between multiple organizations

Whether you are a Project Manager looking for a user-friendly way to observe your Azure DevOps projects, or a developer curious to monitor your work, Az DevOps provides a fast and simple way to make the most of Azure DevOps on the go.

If you are interested in the technical side of Az DevOps, feel free to check out our GitHub repository where you can see the code, report issues, and even contribute. Visit https://github.com/PurpleSoftSrl/azure_devops_app to learn more.

Disclaimer: this is not an official Microsoft product.
